content:
Priya: Heads up — finalizing paid plan for the May webinar cohort. Need quick sync on search keywords, retargeting window, and creative refresh cadence.
Jorge: Sounds good. What's the budget cadence we should assume for week 0 vs week 1?
Priya: Thinking: week 0 (teaser) 20% daily cap, week 1 (registration push) 60% cap, then 20% sustain. Open to tweaks.
Lina: Agree on front-loading. For retargeting we should do 14-day site visitors for the event page and 7-day viewers for the teaser vid.
Sam: Can we do a control group with static creative vs dynamic CTA? Want to see headline lift.
Priya: Yes — split 40/40/20 (static / dynamic CTA / control). Sam will own the control setup.
Jorge: Search keywords — prioritize product-intent + webinar intent: "llm inference best practices", "model serving webinar", "inference cost optimization". Add a broad match modifier for long tails.
Lina: I'll add negative keywords to exclude generic "how to build llm" queries. Also set bid caps at campaign level to control CPC.
MarketingOpsBot: Reminder: creative refresh cooldown is 72h to let the algo stabilize. See runbook: /docs/ads/creative-ops.md
Priya: For inbound routing: new registrants go to SFDC lead queue "Webinar Mktg" + Slack alert to #sales-inbound. High-intent (job title + company size) flagged for SDRs.
Sam: For lead scoring, can we add token: "attended-demo" if they click product tour CTA in the confirmation email?
Priya: Yeah — add a campaign UTM parameter utm_campaign=may-webinar-v1 and pass utm_content to lead record. That will help attribution and scoring.
Lina: Creative cadence: hero image swap every 3 days, headline A/B every 4 days, CTA test lives for 7 days.
Jorge: Budget pacing — set accelerated delivery for week 0 and standard for week 1 to avoid exhausting spend too early. Also enable dayparting: 9am–6pm target for core regions (NA/EU).
Priya: Quick snippet for the ops team — schedule config to upload:```
{
  "campaign": "may-webinar-v1",
  "budget_daily": 2000,
  "pacing": {"week0": 0.2, "week1": 0.6, "post": 0.2},
  "daypart": "09:00-18:00",
  "retarget_windows": {"page_visitors": 14, "video_viewers": 7}
}```
Sam: I'll create the control ad groups and share the draft creatives by EOD.
Lina: I'll push the negative keyword list and the bid caps to the shared sheet.
Priya: Awesome — can we all check back tomorrow 10am PT for a final pre-launch signoff? @Jorge @Lina @Sam :thumbsup:
Jorge: Yep.
Sam: On it.
MarketingOpsBot: Task created: "May webinar paid setup" assigned to Priya, Jorge, Lina, Sam. Due: 1755587600 (2025-06-18 17:00 UTC).
